summary: Fort Technology Inc, a Toronto-based foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K disclosing securities purchase agreements dated November 11, 2026 with institutional investors for up to $20M aggregate principal of unsecured convertible notes plus warrants, sold at a 10% original issue discount (each Note purchased at 90% of principal). Initial closing: $1.1M principal per investor for $990,000, issued at a mutually agreed date. The Company may require quarterly additional purchases of up to $1.1M principal per investor, subject to trading-volume conditions, capped at $10M principal per investor. Notes carry 8% interest (14% on default), 28-month maturity, ten equal monthly installments beginning month 19, no-prepayment-premium option, and investor conversion at the lower of a fixed price (closing price prior to issuance) or a variable price. A $500,000 commitment fee per investor is payable in Common Shares based on three-day VWAP before closing. The Company must file an F-1/F-3 resale registration within 30 trading days and seek effectiveness within 60 (or 90 with full SEC review) calendar days. This is a structured equity-linked financing, not a conventional special situation. Watch dilution from variable-price conversion, resale-registration overhang, and volume-linked drawdown triggers.
